WoW: Forever · Healer · Updated October 31, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70707 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta closed on October 23 at level 30, so nothing above 30 was tested by players; talents and spells past 30 come from the launch client and Blizzard's posts. Party members must be within 44 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration. is the 31-point capstone, so level 40, and no beta player cast it. No source had posted a level 30 build when this page was written. The level 30 line below is built on the full talent tree's point costs, not a build any guide has recommended. These pages follow the hotfix Blizzard pushed to the launch realms on October 30, read from the game's hotfix data. Blizzard has not announced it, so it may still move before November 4. If a tooltip on this page differs from the text, go by the text.

What Restoration is for

Keeping a party up on heals that are already running before the damage lands. Every RejuvenationRejuvenationLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 11CastInstantCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration12 secHeals the target for 32 over 12 sec. or RegrowthRegrowthLevel 12 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 9Cast2 sec castCost70 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration21 secHeals a friendly target for 89 to 103 and another 91 over 21 sec. that runs its full duration pays out once more through BloomBloomTalentCastInstantDuration10 secAfflicts the target with a poison that takes root after 10 sec. When Bloom expires it roots the target in place, dealing intense Nature damage over 10 sec., so blanketing a group ahead of time is worth the Mana (ours, not a source's). SwiftmendSwiftmendTalentCastInstantCost20% of base ManaRange40 yd rangeCooldown15 sec cooldownInstantly heals a target with an active Rejuvenation or Regrowth effect for an amount equal to the full duration of the periodic effect of one of those spells. then turns one running RejuvenationRejuvenationLevel 4 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 11CastInstantCost25 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration12 secHeals the target for 32 over 12 sec. or RegrowthRegrowthLevel 12 · Spell · Nature · Rank 1 of 9Cast2 sec castCost70 ManaRange40 yd rangeDuration21 secHeals a friendly target for 89 to 103 and another 91 over 21 sec. into an instant heal for its full periodic duration, and leaves it ticking.

The published verdict measures solo kill speed, and it also says you can heal dungeons the whole way: "While it is very possible to level as a healing spec like Restoration Druid, it will result in a much longer journey than levelling as Feral or Balance instead. You will be very hard to kill, but our damage is just too low to do the job efficiently. If you're open to the other specs, then it can be best to level as one of those, and you can still heal dungeons while you level if you like." Blizzard's own class deep dive backs the same complaint at class level: Druid healing "relies on healing-over-time (HoT) spells that require more planning."

Level Feral, then respec to Restoration when you want to heal (ours, not a source's). Druid respeccing costs the same as anyone's.

Stat priority

Healing Power and Spell Power equally, then Intellect, Spirit, critical strike, Haste.

"Intellect decides how long you can keep casting, Spirit how quickly the bar refills once you stop. Stamina counts for very little here, and spell damage for nothing." Icy Veins places Haste last for the same reason: healing over time does not scale with haste at all, and there are no haste breakpoints for it.

Item level first while levelling: take the higher piece.
